text: キャタピー　なんか　じゃ　ダメか

structure.jp: キャタピー　なんか　じゃ

patterns.name: 〜なんか
patterns.span: キャタピー　なんか
patterns.explanation: なんか after a thing means 'something like', and looks down on it. キャタピー　なんか = 'something like a mere Caterpie'.

patterns.name: 〜ではだめだ
patterns.explanation: では plus だめ means 'that won't be good enough'; じゃ is the short spoken form of では. じゃ　ダメ = 'is no good'.

patterns.name: 〜か (realizing)
patterns.explanation: か at the end with a falling voice is not a question but a 'so that's how it is' said to yourself. ダメか = 'so it's no good, huh'.
